name: deposit
description: Agent that can report about deposit accounts

skills.name: Deposit Balance
skills.description: Get the balance and transaction history on a specific deposit account
examples: What is my balance on the vacation account?
What was my most recent payment on my main account?

skills.name: Check Minimum Balance
skills.description: Checks whether the total balance of all deposit accounts meets a minimum threshold
examples: Is the total balance of all my deposit accounts greater than 5000?
